text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Where could it be~? Are you here~? Maybe 
here?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
The Slit-Mouthed Umamusume I saw on 
“Mysterious Stories of the World”~.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
With legs like that, if that Umamusume 
with the slit mouth chases after you, 
there's no escape...! Running together 
with her would feel absolutely marvelous☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Inside the gate~? Behind the goal post~? 
Buried in the dirt track sand~?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I wanna meet the marvelous slit-mouthed 
Umamusume☆ Where are you~! Let's run 
together★☆★

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Having believed the story she saw on TV, 
Marvelous Sunday began staying up rather 
late."
